para_trans: Government Decision No: BCC-2026 / P.No.73 (E-1813998) / Reservation-5
The functions of the Committee shall be as follows: -
Reservation of open and reserved categories for filling up of direct service posts in smaller cadres.
Representation of all categories in an equitable manner, taking into account the prevailing percentage
Suggest measures to the government to revise the list of points to be obtained.
The Committee shall submit its report to the Government within three months.
The Government decision is available on the Government's www.maharashtra.gov.in website.
